purpose: Calibration cases; not reusable supporter copy or publication candidates.

cases.reason: Distinctive formation context changes understanding of the club.

cases.summary: Leicester and Filbert Street continuity

cases.reason: Explains meaningful identity continuity.

cases.reason: Supporter action materially shaped the club's survival.

cases.summary: Nordecke supporter culture
cases.reason: Named place and evidenced supporter practice prepare a visitor for the experience.

cases.summary: Portland Victory Log ritual
cases.reason: Distinctive match ritual tells a supporter what they will see and why it matters.

cases.summary: Named station and walking route
cases.reason: Lets the supporter act and avoids a likely journey error.

cases.summary: Named recurring supporter destination with map location
cases.reason: Provides a real place and audience context before the match.

cases.summary: Use the official ticket route
cases.reason: Routes elsewhere without providing a method, rule, or restriction.

cases.summary: Consult the A-to-Z guide
cases.reason: Delegates the work and contains no supporter-useful guidance.

cases.summary: Confirm venue and kickoff before travel
cases.reason: Generic caution presented as arrival information.

cases.summary: Venue is the club's canonical home
cases.reason: Repeats relationship metadata without adding meaning.

cases.summary: Public transport options are available
cases.reason: No named route, stop, walk, or caveat.

cases.summary: Generic community mission
cases.reason: Interchangeable mission language provides no distinctive experience.

cases.summary: Parking instruction duplicated on one page
cases.reason: Consumes attention without adding information.

cases.summary: Generic ticket guidance added only to fill a category
cases.reason: Universal usefulness and disappearance standards prohibit quota-driven filler.

cases.summary: A well-evidenced regional lower-level rivalry that materially shapes fixture choice
cases.reason: Significance is established in the appropriate regional and pyramid context without lowering evidence or usefulness standards.

cases.summary: A surviving ground that is a distinctive classic of its Scottish football level
cases.reason: A ground need not match major-stadium scale when it genuinely stands out in the appropriate football context and changes the visit.

cases.summary: The oldest or largest local example with no demonstrated supporter value
cases.reason: Relative distinction alone does not establish material matchgoer significance.

cases.summary: Zero DECIDE returned without deliberate research of all five categories
cases.reason: Zero is valid only after the country's DECIDE landscape has been deliberately investigated and adjudicated.

cases.summary: Useful arrival and ticket information published while CLUB and SUPPORTERS were never investigated
cases.reason: Practical value cannot substitute for deliberate research into meaningful club identity and supporter culture.

cases.summary: Strong facts exist and endpoints return 200 but rendered pages bury or omit them
cases.reason: Data presence and HTTP success do not prove that the supporter-facing product presents the strongest value.

cases.summary: Representative page remains sparse after all modules and contextual candidates are deliberately assessed
cases.reason: A deliberate evidence-based zero preserves the universal no-filler standard.
